name: cli-anything
tagline_zh: 把任意GUI应用或代码仓库，变成可测试、可验证的命令行工具。不用改一行Python，Codex直接套用完整方法论。
tagline_en: Turn any GUI app or repo into a testable CLI harness. No Python edits—Codex applies the full methodology as-is.
desc_en: Use when the user wants Codex to build, refine, test, validate, or list CLI-Anything harnesses for GUI applications or source repositories. Adapts the full CLI-Anything methodology to Codex without changing the generated Python harness format.
why_zh: 同类工具要你手写适配层，它却零改动复用官方流程，连生成的harness格式都保持一致。
why_en: No adapter code needed—it reuses the official pipeline verbatim, keeping the generated harness format identical.
